entries.title: Joel 3:1
segments: ¶"For behold, in those days and at that time, When I bring back the captives of Judah and Jerusalem,

entries.title: Joel 3:2
segments: I will also gather all nations, And bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat; And I will enter into judgment with them there On account of My people, My heritage Israel, Whom they have scattered among the nations; They have also divided up My land.

entries.title: Joel 3:3
segments: They have cast lots for My people, Have given a boy [as payment] for a harlot, And sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.

entries.title: Joel 3:4
segments: "Indeed, what have you to do with Me, O Tyre and Sidon, and all the coasts of Philistia? Will you retaliate against Me? But if you retaliate against Me, Swiftly and speedily I will return your retaliation upon your own head;

entries.title: Joel 3:5
segments: Because you have taken My silver and My gold, And have carried into your temples My prized possessions.

entries.title: Joel 3:6
segments: Also the people of Judah and the people of Jerusalem You have sold to the Greeks, That you may remove them far from their borders.

entries.title: Joel 3:7
segments: "Behold, I will raise them Out of the place to which you have sold them, And will return your retaliation upon your own head.

entries.title: Joel 3:8
segments: I will sell your sons and your daughters Into the hand of the people of Judah, And they will sell them to the Sabeans, To a people far off; For the LORD has spoken."

entries.title: Joel 3:9
segments: ¶Proclaim this among the nations: "Prepare for war! Wake up the mighty men, Let all the men of war draw near, Let them come up.

entries.title: Joel 3:10
segments: Beat your plowshares into swords And your pruning hooks into spears; Let the weak say, 'I [am] strong.'"

entries.title: Joel 3:11
segments: Assemble and come, all you nations, And gather together all around. Cause Your mighty ones to go down there, O LORD.

entries.title: Joel 3:12
segments: "Let the nations be wakened, and come up to the Valley of Jehoshaphat; For there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.

entries.title: Joel 3:13
segments: Put in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, go down; For the winepress is full, The vats overflow-For their wickedness [is] great."

entries.title: Joel 3:14
segments: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the LORD [is] near in the valley of decision.

entries.title: Joel 3:15
segments: The sun and moon will grow dark, And the stars will diminish their brightness.

entries.title: Joel 3:16
segments: The LORD also will roar from Zion, And utter His voice from Jerusalem; The heavens and earth will shake; But the LORD will be a shelter for His people, And the strength of the children of Israel.

entries.title: Joel 3:17
segments: "So you shall know that I [am] the LORD your God, Dwelling in Zion My holy mountain. Then Jerusalem shall be holy, And no aliens shall ever pass through her again."

entries.title: Joel 3:18
segments: ¶And it will come to pass in that day [That] the mountains shall drip with new wine, The hills shall flow with milk, And all the brooks of Judah shall be flooded with water; A fountain shall flow from the house of the LORD And water the Valley of Acacias.

entries.title: Joel 3:19
segments: "Egypt shall be a desolation, And Edom a desolate wilderness, Because of violence [against] the people of Judah, For they have shed innocent blood in their land.

entries.title: Joel 3:20
segments: But Judah shall abide forever, And Jerusalem from generation to generation.

entries.title: Joel 3:21
segments: "For I will acquit them of the guilt of bloodshed, whom I had not acquitted; For the LORD dwells in Zion."
